stories.title: Mendonça libera sigilo de mais documentos do caso Master

en.title: Mendonça releases confidentiality of more documents in Master case
en.summary: Minister André Mendonça of Brazil's Supreme Court released confidential documents from the Master case on Friday night. The Attorney General's Office requested the removal of confidentiality from all Master case documents, arguing that partial disclosure could create a false impression of transparency.

stories.title: Zanin refaz pedido de acesso a celular de Vorcaro e Moraes diz que Mendonça protege ‘grupo político’

en.title: Zanin remakes request for access to Vorcaro's cell phone and Moraes says Mendonça protects 'political group'
en.summary: Zanin submitted a new request for access to Vorcaro's mobile phone. Moraes alleged that Mendonça is protecting a political group.

stories.title: Mendonça diz ter divulgado todo conteúdo disponível no caso Master

en.title: Mendonça says he disclosed all available content in Master case
en.summary: Minister André Mendonça stated on Friday that he fully released all procedures contained in or related to the Master case judgment scheduled for Tuesday. Mendonça responded to Minister Alexandre de Moraes's allegation of selective confidentiality release, citing prudent analysis and ongoing investigations.

stories.title: Gilmar sugere adiar sessão do STF sobre Moraes e juntar caso a relatório que mira Mendonça

en.title: Gilmar suggests postponing STF session on Moraes and joining case to report targeting Mendonça
en.summary: Minister Gilmar Mendes, the senior justice of Brazil's Supreme Court, has requested that the court's president postpone a scheduled ruling for next Tuesday to combine it with another investigation.

es.title: Gilmar sugiere aplazar sesión del STF sobre Moraes y unir caso a informe que apunta a Mendonça
es.summary: El ministro Gilmar Mendes, decano de la Corte Suprema brasileña, solicitó al presidente del tribunal que postponga un fallo programado para la próxima semana a fin de vincularlo con otra investigación.

fr.title: Gilmar suggère de reporter la session du STF sur Moraes et de fusionner l'affaire avec le rapport visant Mendonça
fr.summary: Le ministre Gilmar Mendes, doyen de la Cour suprême brésilienne, a demandé au président du tribunal de reporter un jugement prévu pour la semaine prochaine afin de le combiner avec une autre enquête.

pt.title: Gilmar sugere adiar sessão do STF sobre Moraes e juntar caso a relatório que mira Mendonça
pt.summary: O ministro Gilmar Mendes, decano do Supremo Tribunal Federal, enviou ofício ao presidente da corte solicitando o adiamento de um julgamento marcado para a próxima terça, visando a associá-lo a outra investigação.

de.title: Gilmar schlägt vor, STF-Sitzung zu Moraes zu verschieben und Fall mit Bericht zu Mendonça zu verbinden
de.summary: Minister Gilmar Mendes, der Alterspräsident des brasilianischen Obersten Gerichtshofs, hat den Gerichtspräsidenten gebeten, eine für nächste Woche angesetzte Entscheidung zu verschieben und mit einer anderen Untersuchung zu verbinden.

it.title: Gilmar suggerisce di rinviare la sessione della STF su Moraes e unire il caso al rapporto che mira a Mendonça
it.summary: Il ministro Gilmar Mendes, decano della Corte suprema brasiliana, ha chiesto al presidente del tribunale di rinviare una sentenza programmata per la prossima settimana al fine di collegarla a un'altra indagine.

ru.title: Жилмар предлагает отложить заседание STF по делу Мораэса и объединить его с докладом о расследовании Мендонсы
ru.summary: Министр Жилмар Мендеш, старший член Верховного суда Бразилии, попросил президента суда отложить запланированное на следующую неделю решение, чтобы объединить его с другим расследованием.

ar.title: جيلمار يقترح تأجيل جلسة محكمة العدل العليا بشأن مورايس وضم القضية إلى تقرير يستهدف مندونسا
ar.summary: طلب الوزير جيلمار مندش، الأقدم بين قضاة محكمة العدل العليا البرازيلية، من رئيس المحكمة تأجيل حكم مقرر للأسبوع القادم لدمجه مع تحقيق آخر.

hi.title: गिलमार ने मोराएस पर सर्वोच्च न्यायालय की सुनवाई स्थगित करने और मेंडोंका की रिपोर्ट के साथ केस को जोड़ने का सुझाव दिया
hi.summary: ब्राजील के सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के वरिष्ठ न्यायाधीश गिलमार मेंडेस ने न्यायालय के अध्यक्ष से अगले हफ्ते के लिए निर्धारित फैसले को स्थगित करने का अनुरोध किया है।

zh.title: 吉尔马建议推迟最高联邦法院关于莫拉埃斯的会议，并将案件与针对门多萨的报告合并
zh.summary: 巴西最高联邦法院资深法官吉尔马·门德什请求法院院长推迟下周计划的裁决，以便将其与另一项调查合并。

ja.title: ジルマルがモラエス関連のSTF会議の延期とメンドンサを対象とする報告書への事件統合を提案
ja.summary: ブラジル最高裁判所の筆頭判事ジルマル・メンデス氏が、来週予定されている判決の延期を求め、別の調査と統合することを要請した。

ko.title: 질마르, 모라에스 관련 최고연방법원 회의 연기 및 멘돈사 대상 보고서와 사건 합병 제안
ko.summary: 브라질 최고연방법원의 최선임 판사인 질마르 멘데스 장관이 법원 원장에게 다음 주 예정된 판결을 연기하여 다른 조사와 통합해달라고 요청했다.

stories.title: Lula tem 46% no segundo turno contra 44% de Flávio Bolsonaro, diz Datafolha

en.title: Lula has 46% in runoff against 44% of Flávio Bolsonaro, says Datafolha
en.summary: A Datafolha poll shows Lula with 46 percent support in a hypothetical runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro at 44 percent.

stories.title: Datafolha: Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula são rejeitados por 46% dos eleitores

en.title: Datafolha: Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula are rejected by 46% of voters
en.summary: A Datafolha poll finds that 46% of voters reject both senator Flávio Bolsonaro and president Lula, stating they would not vote for either candidate under any circumstances.

stories.title: Datafolha: Lula tem 39%, e Flávio, 35% no 1º turno; rivais empatam no 2º

en.title: Datafolha: Lula has 39%, and Flávio 35% in first round; rivals tie in second
en.summary: A Datafolha survey conducted during the Supreme Court crisis shows president Lula leading with 39% support against senator Flávio Bolsonaro's 35% in a first-round scenario, with the candidates tied in a potential runoff.

stories.title: Mendonça nega pedido de Moraes para abrir tudo do caso Master por haver ‘investigações em andamento’

en.title: Mendonça denies Moraes' request to open all Master case records due to 'ongoing investigations'
en.summary: Justice Mendonça rejected a request from Justice Moraes to fully disclose Master case records, citing ongoing investigations as the reason.

stories.title: Zanin reforça pedido de acesso a celular de Vorcaro após Mendonça dizer que dados estão lacrados

en.title: Zanin reinforces request for access to Vorcaro's cell phone after Mendonça says data are sealed
en.summary: Supreme Court Justice Cristiano Zanin reiterated his request for full access to Daniel Vorcaro's cell phone following Justice André Mendonça's refusal to grant the disclosure in the Master Bank case.

stories.title: Diretor da PF: Moraes usou inquérito das fake news para pedir envio de relatório contra Mendonça

en.title: PF Director: Moraes used fake news inquiry to request report against Mendonça
en.summary: According to the Federal Police director, Justice Minister Moraes utilized a fake news investigation to request submission of a report concerning Minister Mendonça.

stories.title: Zanin rebate Mendonça e reitera pedido para ter cópia integral de dados do celular de Vorcaro

en.title: Zanin rebuts Mendonça and reiterates request to obtain full copy of Vorcaro's phone data
en.summary: STF Minister Cristiano Zanin disputed Minister André Mendonça's position and renewed his insistence that the Master inquiry's rapporteur provide colleagues with complete access to Vorcaro's phone data.

stories.title: Toledo: 'Datafolha é boa notícia para Lula e Flávio; efeito Cury acabou'

en.title: Toledo: 'Datafolha is good news for Lula and Flávio; Cury effect has ended'
en.summary: Political analyst José Roberto de Toledo indicates that recent Datafolha polling shows favorable results for both Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, with the electoral race remaining competitive and open.

stories.title: Datafolha: 50% desaprovam e 47% aprovam governo Lula

en.title: Datafolha: 50% disapprove and 47% approve of Lula government
en.summary: A Datafolha survey released Friday shows President Lula's government at 50% disapproval and 47% approval, with minor changes from the previous week's results remaining within the margin of error.

stories.title: Exclusivo: BC arquiva inquérito da liquidação da Reag Trust e reverte indisponibilidade de bens; outras investigações seguem

en.title: Exclusive: Central Bank files away Reag Trust liquidation inquiry and reverses asset unavailability; other investigations continue
en.summary: Brazil's Central Bank has closed an investigation into CBSF DTVM (formerly Reag Trust DTVM) related to its extrajudicial liquidation and lifted asset restrictions on former administrators and controllers, including founder João Carlos Mansur. Other related investigations remain ongoing.

stories.title: CVM proíbe uso de taxa de performance em FIDC para remunerar consultor

en.title: CVM prohibits use of performance fee in FIDC to remunerate consultant
en.summary: Brazil's Securities Commission has ruled that credit rights investment funds cannot allocate performance fees, even partially, to specialized consultants hired by fund managers.

stories.title: Trump comete gafe em cerimônia pelos 25 anos do 11 de Setembro

en.title: Trump makes gaffe at 25-year September 11 ceremony
en.summary: President Donald Trump attended a commemoration of the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks at the Pentagon, where 184 of the nearly 3,000 victims died in the 2001 terrorist attacks.

stories.title: Troca de mensagens mostra monitoramento de ações do Master e do BRB por Vorcaro: 'Atenção total'

en.title: Message exchange shows Vorcaro's monitoring of Master and BRB actions: 'Total attention'
en.summary: Messages between former banker Daniel Vorcaro and Luiz Phillipi Mourão reveal Vorcaro directed surveillance of confidential proceedings involving Banco Master and Banco de Brasília at the Federal Public Ministry. Vorcaro responded requesting complete access to all processes.
